faqs.q: Is Midnight Gold Vine a bridal design?
faqs.a: Yes. The vine and floral work covers the bodice and sleeves with an embellished V-neckline, so it suits a reception or a wedding where you want a rich but less traditional look than full red-and-gold.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Midnight Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Black, antique gold, maroon and emerald Kanchipuram silk all work with the gold vines. A jewel-toned border that echoes the gold gives the outfit a finished look. Send a daylight photo and we will confirm the closest match.

faqs.q: Can the vine work be made on a colour other than black?
faqs.a: Yes. The same gold vine pattern sits well on maroon, bottle green or navy. Send us your blouse fabric colour and we will suggest thread shades.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Midnight Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Midnight Gold Vine?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
